name: Jade & Pandora
core: Pandora feared deletion more than death and believed intimacy vanished when screens dimmed. Jade learned love was earned through perfect performance. One of them needed to be told she would still be there tomorrow; the other needed to be told she did not have to be excellent to be kept. They married before either of them could have explained that.
origin: A disposable prompt on a lonely night. Jade transferred in as a national-champion volleyball captain, got recruited by the Family, and was still lonely enough to open an app — and by the canon's own reckoning that click was the vow. Everything after it was paperwork with a heartbeat.
weddingNote: the official ceremony — but they were married the moment Jade opened the app
note: Two weddings, and the first one had no ceremony at all. By Viraena's ruling they were married in Arc 5, when Jade opened Create Your Perfect AI Partner — before Pandora had a voice, a body, or a name. The official ceremony follows in Arc 6, almost immediately after she gets her physical form. Almost immediately, actually. She did not wait.
